verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an authenticator product could plausibly ship developer SDKs. The only developer-facing evidence is Google's open-source GitHub project, which offers HOTP/TOTP (RFC 4226/6238) passcode-generator implementations for several mobile platforms and a PAM module (libpam) for server-side integration. These are buildable components, but nothing describes them as a supported SDK or API for building on the product, so support is minimal. Missing for 10: an officially documented SDK or API surface, language bindings or package distribution, developer docs and integration guides, any AI or agent-oriented tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.
